_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. The selectors below are STARTING GUESSES - run `python qudify_book.py inspect` and correct them until it lists your real room names and slot states.
_palette_comment: RGB of the on-page legend. `inspect` prints the colours it actually sees - paste the real ones here.
_chromium_comment: Optional. Only needed if `playwright install chromium` is blocked on your machine - point this at an installed Chrome/Chromium binary instead. e.g. macOS: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome
